entries.what: Gemini API model gemini-3-pro-preview, shutdown date 2026-03-09 on the deprecations page. Google's pages conflict: the deprecations page lists it as shut down, while the 2026-03-09 changelog says the id now points to gemini-3.1-pro-preview.
lookFor: The model id gemini-3-pro-preview in code or config, including the models/gemini-3-pro-preview form
requires: Remove candidate_count: unsupported on Gemini 3 and later.

gemini-3.1-pro-preview supports thinking levels low, medium and high, default high. minimal is not supported (3.5 guide). The pages list no separate migration steps from gemini-3-pro-preview, so the lines here come from the rules for all Gemini 3.x.
Remove temperature, top_p and top_k: not recommended on all Gemini 3.x (3.5 guide). The pages list no error for them on this model.
Use thinking_level, not thinking_budget. Sending thinking_level and thinking_budget in one request returns a 400.
Function calling: put multimodal content inside the function response, and append inline instructions to the response text after two newlines (3.5 guide).

Function calling: id, name and response count must match the preceding calls. The Interactions API errors on a mismatch. generateContent returns an empty response with finish_reason STOP in most cases (3.5 guide).

Thinking is on by default and max_output_tokens covers thinking plus output: a small cap can stop with status "incomplete" and return truncated or empty text while still billing the thinking tokens. Raise the cap or lower thinking_level (thinking page).
If you manage history yourself, resend every thought block exactly as received, including signatures on built-in tool blocks; do not strip or edit them (thinking page).
On generateContent, pass the full unmodified history, thought signatures included, in contents. The SDKs do this automatically (3.5 guide).

Interactions API: thought steps sit in the steps array alongside model output, and a thought's summary can be empty. Read output_text or filter by step type, not a fixed index. The index advice is a reading of the thinking page.
Image segmentation is not supported on Gemini 3.x (3.5 guide).
The changelog added computer use to gemini-3-pro-preview. The gemini-3.1-pro-preview model page does not list it, so check before moving code that uses it.
It is itself a preview with no shutdown date announced, so it can get one.

On a legacy SDK: the libraries page says the legacy libraries are deprecated as of November 30, 2025, not actively maintained and lack recent features such as Live API and Veo, but not that calls stop working. No page says whether a legacy SDK can send what this replacement needs, so change SDK only if the migrated call requires it: google-generativeai to google-genai (genai.Client(), client.models.generate_content(model=..., contents=...), options in config=); @google/generative-ai to @google/genai (new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey }), ai.models.generateContent({ model, contents }), response.text as a property); github.com/google/generative-ai-go to google.golang.org/genai. Dart: Genkit Dart or Firebase AI Logic. Swift and Android: Firebase AI Logic.

entries.what: Gemini API model veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview, shutdown date 2026-10-22 on the deprecations page.

requires: Omni is documented through the Interactions API (client.interactions.create), not generate_videos or predictLongRunning. Rewriting the call and polling flow is a reading from comparing the Veo and Omni pages; neither page gives a step list.
Read the video from interaction.output_video in the SDK (SDK-only) or from the steps array over REST.
System instructions, temperature, top_p, stop sequences and negative prompts are not supported. Put negatives in the prompt.
Input video for editing or extension must be 10 seconds or less when uploaded; YouTube sources and uploaded audio references are unsupported.
Set resolution in response_format: 360p, 720p (default), 1080p or 4k. The Omni guide's code uses response_format; the changelog says video_config, so the pages disagree.
Aspect ratio goes in response_format: 16:9 (default) or 9:16.
Output is 3 to 10 seconds at 24 FPS. The Omni pages list no durationSeconds, personGeneration or seed; dropping them is a reading.
The video comes back as inline base64. For videos over 4MB set delivery to uri in response_format.
Do not put control strings such as <FIRST_FRAME> or <IMAGE_REF_0> in prompts: deprecated and unsupported in future models.
Editing or extending uploaded videos is not available in the EEA, Switzerland or the UK. Referencing several videos in one prompt is not supported.

A request whose last non-empty turn has role model (a prefill) returns a 400. Use system_instruction or structured outputs instead.
Replace thinking_budget with thinking_level. The default is minimal; set medium or high for subagents with tool calls, code execution or multi-step reasoning, or tools can terminate early.
Sending thinking_level and thinking_budget in one request returns a 400.
minimal does not guarantee thinking is off (3.5 guide).

Thinking is on by default and max_output_tokens covers thinking plus output: a small cap can stop with status "incomplete" and return truncated or empty text while still billing the thinking tokens. Raise the cap or lower thinking_level (thinking page).

Function calling: put multimodal assets inside the response payload, format inline instructions with \n\n, and if pre-tool text causes Malformed_Function_Call errors use the function-calling page's workarounds.

Function calling: id, name and response count must match the preceding calls. The Interactions API errors on a mismatch. generateContent returns an empty response with finish_reason STOP in most cases (3.5 guide).

If you manage history yourself, resend every thought block exactly as received, including signatures on built-in tool blocks; do not strip or edit them (thinking page). The changelog lists thought_signature validation among the breaking changes.
On generateContent, pass the full unmodified history, thought signatures included, in contents. The SDKs do this automatically (3.5 guide).

Interactions API: thought steps sit in the steps array alongside model output, and a thought's summary can be empty. Read output_text or filter by step type, not a fixed index. The index advice is a reading of the thinking page.
Image segmentation is not supported on Gemini 3.x (3.5 guide).
